description: Planned unavailability of grid components (380/220kV) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Planned unavailabilities of 380/220kVgrid components. The future dates are indicative and are based on bilateral consultations with neighbouring transmission system operators. Dear users, On Tuesday, October 14th, 2025, the Ods203 dataset will show the unavailability of grid components in real-time. Please be aware that this dataset will be deleted shortly. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Transmission. Its keywords are Outages, EU Reg. No 534/2013. The portal shows 2025-10-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
